title: Aircraft Service Attendants
description: Service aircraft with fuel. May de-ice aircraft, refill water and cooling agents, empty sewage tanks, service air and oxygen systems, or clean and polish exterior.

projects: Complete foundational aircraft service attendants training
milestones: Apply de-icing fluid to aircraft from baskets lifted by truck-mounted cranes.Related occupations
Change aircraft oil, coolant, or other fluids.Related occupations
Clean aircraft interiors by picking up waste, wiping down windows, or vacuuming.Related occupations
Climb ladders to reach aircraft surfaces to be cleaned.Related occupations
Complete forms describing tasks completed.Related occupations
Empty aircraft lavatory systems or refill them with sanitizer fluid.Related occupations
Guide aircraft to designated areas using hand signals, batons, or other methods.Related occupations
Inspect aircraft components to locate cracks, breaks, leaks, or other problems.Related occupations
